items.title: IT majors see strong deal pipeline but revenue momentum cools in Q4
items.description: Indian IT firms are seeing steady new deals and operating margins. However, revenue growth is slowing down quarter-on-quarter because projects are delayed. Artificial intelligence also poses a risk to future earnings. Companies like Infosys and HCLTech have given cautious growth forecasts for the upcoming financial year. IT stocks may face pressure in the short term.
